attribution.note: Marcus's own prediction in his 2025 predictions post on his Substack. He wrote it and endorses it.

semantics.note: The context shows the line sits under the 'Medium confidence' heading, before the 'Low confidence' section. Revision 2 correctly keeps that graded-confidence label. It is a forecast with medium confidence, which the policy does not score.

contract.note: The contract is fair to his words: it treats the heading as his own medium confidence and does not score the prediction. 'Trouble with physics' also has no stated measure. Neither point changes the not-scored result.

evidence.note: OpenAI's own launch post for Sora 2 (30 Sep 2025), inside the horizon. It says the model is 'still imperfect' at physics but better than before. This is a company disclosure, not an independent test. Because the prediction is not scored, it is context only.

output.rationale: Marcus filed this prediction under 'Medium confidence'.
